Decision Table for Unit U14_Self_Test

| Condition / Rule | RW-SW-1 | RW-SW-2 | RW-SW-3 | RW-SW-159 | RW-SW-160 | Action |
|------------------|----------|----------|----------|------------|------------|--------|
| 1                | Pass     | Pass     | Pass     | Pass       | Pass       | Execute self-test |
| 2                | Fail     | -        | -        | -          | -          | Report O2 sensor accuracy failure |
| 3                | -        | Pass     | Pass     | -          | -          | Validate blower response |
| 4                | -        | Fail     | -        | -          | -          | Report blower response failure |
| 5                | -        | -        | Pass     | -          | -          | Validate pinch valve pressure response |
| 6                | -        | -        | Fail     | -          | -          | Report pinch valve pressure response failure |
| 7                | -        | -        | -        | Pass       | -          | Validate audible alarm devices |
| 8                | -        | -        | -        | Fail       | -          | Report audible alarm devices failure |
| 9                | -        | -        | -        | -          | Pass       | Validate visual alarm devices |
| 10               | -        | -        | -        | -          | Fail       | Report visual alarm devices failure |

Notes:
- "-" indicates a "don't-care" condition (irrelevant for this rule).
- Each row represents a distinct rule/path through the self-test logic.
- Actions are triggered based on the pass/fail conditions for each requirement.
